blockbuilder-explorer.visual_critic_note: Cohesive dark-theme dashboard with a restrained CSS variable system, consistent accent color, and a clear multi-panel layout (timeline brush → dual network/color panels → thumbnail gallery), though the force-directed graph is too dense at rendered size to extract individual node relationships.
blockbuilder-explorer.encoding_integrity_note: Zero baseline on bar chart, scaleSqrt used correctly for all bubble encodings, data-driven domains throughout; minor subset-relation violation in network where node radii rescale to filtered max rather than holding original reference frame.
blockbuilder-explorer.stress_test_note: Excellent RAF dirty-flag pattern coalesces all cross-view updates; no feedback loops or mid-flight transitions; brush scales captured at init in closures with no resize handler creates a stale-scale risk if the viewport is resized.
blockbuilder-explorer.cognitive_load_note: Four cross-linked panels (timeline, network, colors, thumbnails) are at the edge of working memory; the 60-node force layout reads as a near-hairball in the screenshot with dense edge crossings that obscure API groupings, while the remaining panels are clean and well-labeled.
